cat > /tmp/lvm-loop-setup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
for img in /var/lib/lvm-backing/*.img; do
    losetup -j "$img" | grep -q "$img" || losetup -f "$img"
done
udevadm settle
vgscan --mknodes
vgchange -ay
EOF
sudo mv /tmp/lvm-loop-setup.sh /usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh
